Source: https://github.com/hufrea/byedpi/tree/v0.17.3
Version: v0.17.3
License: MIT (see LICENSE).
Android executables: built by tool/build_byedpi.ps1 using Android NDK 28, API 24. The only local core change is PR_SET_PDEATHSIG in main.c so the child exits when its app parent dies.
Windows executable: official byedpi-17.3-x86_64-w64.zip release, https://github.com/hufrea/byedpi/releases/tag/v0.17.3.
